## Learning goal

I can identify a real user's needs, necessities, constraints, and nice-to-have features before designing.

<figure>
<img src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ/export/png?id=1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ&amp;pageid=p4" alt="Needs and necessities stage of the N.I.C.E. process." style="display:block;max-width:960px;width:100%;margin-inline:auto">
<figcaption>Figure 2. Define what the solution must accomplish before choosing the solution.</figcaption>
</figure>

::: {.worksheet-actions}
<p>Use the page to preview every question, then complete your own copy.</p>

[Make a copy of the N.I.C.E. Needs Worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19ObkJz3sYVXwB9VkNUiybXZGZ-ihuGw1FarRj81LtAo/copy)
:::

Do not jump to solutions yet. First understand the situation, the people affected, what must be achieved, and what limits the design. Use facts and evidence where possible.

::: {.worksheet-section}
## 1. Situation

<p class="worksheet-question"><strong>What is happening?</strong> What are you being asked to design, improve, or solve?</p>

<div class="response-space" aria-label="Space to record the situation"></div>
:::

::: {.worksheet-section}
## 2. User or stakeholder

<p class="worksheet-question"><strong>Who is this for?</strong> What matters to the people affected?</p>

<div class="response-space" aria-label="Space to record the user or stakeholder"></div>
:::

::: {.worksheet-section}

## 4. Needs, requirements, and restrictions

A need is something the solution must address. Requirements and restrictions are conditions the solution has to work within.

<table class="needs-table needs-table--three">

:::

::: {.worksheet-section}
## 5. Necessities and nice-to-haves

Necessities are required for the solution to work. Nice-to-haves could improve the solution but are not required.

:::

::: {.worksheet-section}

## 7. Need statement

Complete this in one or two sentences:

<p class="need-statement"><strong>The user needs</strong> ___ <strong>because</strong> ___ <strong>while considering</strong> ___.</p>

“We need a laser-cut name tag” already chooses the product. “A new classmate needs to identify who they are speaking with quickly and from a useful distance” keeps the problem open.
:::

## Review and reflection

- What did you learn or make?
- What evidence shows that your work is complete and correct?
- What will you improve next time?
- What extra idea, test, improvement, or related topic did you investigate?
